tax.title: Your tax details
tax.intro: We need them to invoice you our fee, and because the tax authorities require us to collect and report them (DAC7 rules). What Stripe already knew is filled in; you only need to add your tax ID.
tax.requiredNotice: Until you complete them, your sales are still collected, but we don't transfer the money to you. It's kept safe and reaches you as soon as you complete them.
tax.heldNotice: You have {count, plural, one {# sale} other {# sales}} on hold because these details are missing. The money is safe: we transfer it as soon as you complete them.
tax.savedComplete: Details saved. Any sales on hold because of this are on their way.
tax.prefillNote: We've filled in what Stripe gave us. Check it and add your tax ID.
tax.taxIdHintEs: Your Spanish DNI or NIE with the letter, or your company NIF.
tax.taxIdHintOther: Your tax identification number in your country.
tax.taxIdSavedHint: Saved: •••• {hint}. Only type it if it changes.
tax.vatIdHintEs: If you are registered for intra-EU operations (ES + your NIF).
tax.vatIdHintEu: If you have one, the invoice has no VAT (you account for it). Without it, our 5% includes Spanish VAT.
tax.vatIdSavedHint: Saved: •••• {hint}. Only type it if it changes.
tax.birthDateHint: The tax authorities ask for it for individuals selling on platforms.
tax.privacyNote: We store these details encrypted and only use them for your invoices and what the tax authorities require.
